# Repository AI Instructions

## Core principles
- Extraction is evidence, not normative truth.
- Parser disagreement must remain explicit.
- Accepted elements must remain traceable to source evidence.
- Source identity and integrity must be preserved.
- Acceptance gates must not be bypassed.

## Engineering
- Keep the generic NDI layer domain-independent.
- Prefer deterministic contracts and reproducible fixtures.
- Large PDF/benchmark workflows should be manual unless they are lightweight enough for PR CI.
